beats.summary: Andy is sailing and communicating via computer, showing his struggles and humor.

evidence.snippet: Andy (on computer screen): Ah, what else? I've seen Dirty Dancing like, ten times.

beats.summary: Dwight receives a call from David Wallace about a new sales opportunity with the Scranton White Pages.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (answEring phone): Dwight Schrute. Well, hi there David Wallace.

beats.summary: Dwight has a problem with women which may affect his ability to sell to a female client.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Dwight, you can't go. You have a problem with women. You can't sell to them.
Dwight: That is a damnable lie. I love women.

beats.summary: Jim has a conference call for a new company he is helping start, feeling excited about work.

evidence.snippet: Jim: I have this conference call today with this company in Philly that I'm helping start.

beats.summary: Office men participate in Movember to raise awareness for prostate cancer, growing mustaches.

evidence.snippet: Pete: Toby got us all to participate in Movember. It's a charity for prostate cancer.
Toby: I am so glad I got all of the dudes to do Movember.

beats.summary: Angela suspects a senator is having an affair and discusses it with Oscar.

evidence.snippet: Angela (whispEring): I think the senator is having an affair.
Oscar: I just never heard about the senator and yoga…
